items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1978-08-02
items.q: The interviewer mentions Willis ('I got Willis out of the band... Willis was waiting for the band'), but the interviewee (Bernard Steinau) does not speak or confirm any personal interaction or relationship with Willis in the provided transcript.

ctx.x: No, what do you call it? General delivery. Whenever you know you're going to be in the town, you're writing that general delivery in Kentucky or wherever.
I think you got in touch with me or somebody got in touch with me because at that time you say you need a trucker truck. And I got Willis out of the band I was waiting for you.
